title: Normalized tensor presentation for point sections
statement: For a field $k$, let $s=\operatorname{Spec}k$ with its small pro-etale site [def-weil-pbc-proetale-site], and let $B$ be a commutative ring sheaf. Put $R=B(s)$ and let $\Gamma_s$ be the recorded evaluation functor [lem-weil-point-proetale-sections-exact]. A normalized tensor model comprises module comparisons $\Gamma_s(M\otimes_B N)\cong\Gamma_sM\otimes_R\Gamma_sN$, whose inverse is the actual sheaf section tensor, and natural chain comparisons $b_{P,Q}:\Gamma_s\operatorname{Tot}(P\otimes Q)\cong\operatorname{Tot}(\Gamma_sP\otimes\Gamma_sQ)$ [def-pc-tensor-complex-sheaves]. On each bidegree summand the inverse is the module comparison inverse followed by evaluation of the total inclusion. Include the degree-zero unit comparison, the module unit comparison equal to the identity on $R$, additivity and zero-map preservation of evaluation, and preservation of the flat-term K-flat class [def-pc-kflat-complex] and [def-pc-flat-sheaf-modules]. All tensors are the canonical sheaf or ordinary module tensors [lem-weil-pbc-ringed-topoi-derived-tensor-pullback]; no alternative monoidal structure is introduced.
